Competitive Procurement Strategy: Lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract does not include security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service of Canada (CSC) has a requirement to replace Bowden Institution’s existing air-cooled chiller. Background: The existing air-cooled chiller serving the Bowden Institution Administration Building has failed and is no longer operational. Replacement of this critical mechanical asset is required to restore cooling service, support continuity of administrative operations, and provide a reliable, long-term solution that reduces the risk of future operational disruptions and emergency repair costs. Objectives: The Contractor must deliver a fully operational air-cooled chiller in the Administration Building. The air-chilled cooling system the Contractor provides must be designed, installed, and commissioned to provide continuous and dependable cooling under the specified operating conditions. The system must maintain the required cooling capacity and temperature control, operate safely and efficiently, and minimize service interruptions through the use of durable components, appropriate controls, and accessible maintenance provisions. Deliverables: The Contractor must keep Site Disruptions (including, but not limited to noise, dust, and smells) to a minimum. The Contractor must communicate all anticipated disruptions to the CSC Client Representatives a minimum of five (5) working days in advance to allow CSC to issue site-wide notifications. Schedule: a)The Contractor must provide the anticipated construction duration based on continuous execution of the project once mobilized, subject to CSC operational constraints. b)The Contractor must perform the work during Bowden institution’s normal business hours Monday – Friday from 0800 to 1600 hrs. c)The Contractor must provide a Detailed Schedule upon contract award. Operation & Maintenance documentation: a)The Contractor must provide complete Operation & Maintenance documentation that includes Vendor and Warranty information: b)Documentation must also include as-built drawings, controls sequences, start-up reports, and commissioning records. c)The Contractor must provide one PDF electronic copy to CSC and PSPC. d)The Contractor must also provide one (1) hard copy in printed format, contained within a durable three-ring binder of sufficient capacity to securely hold all documentation without overcrowding. The binder must include a clearly labeled cover and spine identifying the project. The completed binder must be submitted to the CSC Facility Owner Representative at Substantial Completion. Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: none. Estimated quantity of commodity: see solicitation document statement of work and basis of payment. Duration of Contract and Time Frame for Delivery: Construction Time: The Contractor must perform and complete the Work within twenty-eight (28) weeks from the date of notification of acceptance of the offer.

title: Eurajoen Pinkjärven luonnonsuojelualueen Saukonniementien kunnostuksen kilpailutus
description: Metsähallitus kilpailuttaa Pinkjärven luonnonsuojelualueen Saukonniementien peruskunnostuksen tämän tarjouspyynnön sekä liitteenä olevien suunnitelma aineiston mukaisesti. Kunnostettavan osuuden tien pituus noin 5,15 km. Tästä osuudesta on perustettua tietä on 1,373 km (000–2019-K2117). Tien tasoitusleveys on 4,5–5 m. Tieosuudella on neljä (4) pientä parkkialuetta, jotka kunnostetaan tien kunnostuksen yhteydessä. Tie kunnostusurakka kulkee Natura-alueella alun noin 0,852 m matkaa lukuun ottamatta. Tien peruskunnostukselle Natura-alueella on LVV:n myöntämä lupa. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen (2) osa-alueeseen: 1. Kaivinkonetyöt kokonaisurakkana 2. Murskekuormat, yksikköhintaurakkana. Osa-alue 1 kaivinkonetyöt urakka sisältää: - Tien sivuojien kunnostus koko kunnostettavalla osuudella. - Tierungon muotoilu sivuojien kaivun yhteydessä määrättyyn leveyteen ja maakivien poisto. - Sivuojien kaivun yhteydessä samalla työkoneella tehtävä korkeiden reunapalteiden poisto. Kaivumassan määrä pyritään minimoimaan ja se maisemoidaan tien metsänpuoleiseen penkkaan ja ojissa oleva kaikenlainen puuaines nostetaan metsän puolella lahopuuksi. - Rummun asennus, rummun sijainti on merkitty liitteenä olevaan työaluekarttaan. - Päällysrakennetyöt. Osa-alue 2 murskekuormat urakan sisältö: Murskeiden kuljetus ja levitys suunnitelmien ja tilatun mukaisesti. Tarjota voi kumpaakin osa-aluetta tai vain toista. Osa-alueen toteuttajaksi valitaan halvimman tarjouksen tehnyt soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttänyt tarjoaja. Osa-alue 1 kohdalla kyseessä on kokonaisurakka, joka toteutetaan kokonaishinnalla ja urakassa noudatetaan rakennusurakan yleisiä sopimusehtoja YSE 1998 (RT 16–10660). Osa-alueelle 1 valittu urakoitsija toimii pääurakoitsijana ja lainsäädännön tarkoittamana päätoteuttajana. Urakoitsijaa koskee YSE 1 § -4 § tarkoittamat velvollisuudet jos tarjouspyynnössä tai sen liitteenä olevassa aineistossa ei ole muuta mainittu. Työkokonaisuus, materiaalit ja laajuus on esitetty täsmällisemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa suunnitelma-aineistoissa. Tarjoajan tulee tutustua aineistoihin sekä kohteeseen huolellisesti ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Urakka-aika on 1.10.2026-31.3.2027. Urakka on suoritettava yhtäjaksoisesti sen jälkeen kun se on aloitettu. Työkohteet ovat merkitty liitteenä olevaan työaluekarttaan. Tarjousaika päättyy 16.09.2026 klo 16:00., Kaivinkonetyöt Saukonniementien kunnostuksen kaivinkonetyöt., Murskekuormat Saukonniementien kunnostuksen mursketoimitukset.,

title: Netherlands – Construction work for water projects – 31215855: Inrichting Circulaire Werf Duivelseiland (CWD)
description: Rijkswaterstaat heeft ervoor gekozen om een eigen werf in te richten op Krabbegors, een klein eiland in het zeehavengebied van de stad Dordrecht (ook bekend als 'Duivelseiland'). Om het eiland hiervoor geschikt te maken zijn in hoofdzaak de volgende werkzaamheden nodig: aanpassen van kades en oevers, maken van een inkassing in de oever van de Oude Maas, aanbrengen van paalfunderingen t.b.v. steunpunten, aanbrengen van een fundatie en balk voor een skidbaan en het verder inrichting van het werfterrein. De aanbesteder is voornemens deze opdracht te verlenen in de vorm van een engineering & construct contract, met als voorwaarden de UAV-GC 2025. Als onderdeel van het contract wordt een DO verstrekt welke door de toekomstige opdrachtnemer t/m een UO moet worden uitgewerkt. De grootste uitdaging voor de uitvoering is de doorlooptijd: de eindmijlpaal voor dit project is direct gekoppeld aan het startmoment van de eerste gebruiker van de werf, het project 'Vernieuwen Van Brienenoordbrug'. Zie het reeds ingevulde veld m.b.t. de korte beschrijving.

title: Finland – Office supplies – Toimistotarvikkeet
description: Etelä-Savon hyvinvointialue, Eloisa, pyytää tarjouksia toimistotarvikkeista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Toimituskohteet ovat Etelä-Savon hyvinvointialueen toimipisteet. Toimipisteet sijaitsevat Hirvensalmella, Juvalla, Kangasniemellä, Mikkelissä, Mäntyharjulla, Puumalassa, Savonlinnassa, Sulkavalla, Enonkoskella, Rantasalmella ja Pieksämäellä. Toimitustapoja ovat: 1. toimittajan hyllytyspalvelu (täyttöpalvelu). Mikkelin keskussairaalassa ja Savonlinnan sairaalassa on toimistotarvikekaapit/huone, joissa on tietty perustuotevalikoima yleisimmin käytettäviä toimistotarvikkeita. Toimittaja täyttää kerran kuukaudessa toimistotarvikekaappien/huoneen sisällöt. Tuotevalikoimaa muutetaan tarpeen mukaan. Hyllytyspaikkojen määrä on Mikkelissä 2 ja Savonlinnassa 1. Toimittajan kanssa yhteistyössä voidaan suunnitella hyllytyspaikkojen määrä. Täyttöpalvelussa tuotteita ei tilata vaan toimittaja täydentää varaston. Toimittajan pitää seurata itsenäisesti varaston kulutusta ja arvioida ja tilata tarvittavat tuotemäärät aikaisintaan viikkoa ennen seuraavaa toimitusta. 2. tilaaminen verkkokaupasta. Tilaajalla on nimetty henkilöt, joilla on oikeus tilata toimittajan verkkokaupasta tuotteita. Toimittaja perustaa ja ylläpitää käyttäjätunnukset tilaajalle. Verkkokaupan kautta tilataan tuotteita, joita ei ole toimistotarvikekaapissa. Verkkokaupan sisältö sovitaan erikseen yhdessä toimittajan ja tilaajan kesken. Tuotevalikoimaa voidaan muuttaa tarpeen mukaan. Kaikki yksiköt tilaavat verkkokaupan kautta tuotteita. Verkkokauppatilaukset toimitetaan kahden viikon välein eli toimittaja voi koota kahden viikon tilaukset samaan toimitukseen. Tuotteet tulee pakata tilauskohtaisesti. Toimitustavat on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

buyer: Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimiala
title: Finland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Hoitajakutsujärjestelmät
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialan käyttöön tulevat hoitajakutsu-, kaatumisentunnistus- sekä liikkumisen seurantajärjestelmät. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmiä käytetään sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialalla sairaaloissa, seniorikeskuksissa, palvelutaloissa, tehostetun palveluasumisen yksiköissä, terveysasemien vuodeosastoilla, kuntoutusyksiköissä sekä muissa ympärivuorokautista hoitoa ja valvontaa edellyttävissä toimintaympäristöissä. Lisäksi järjestelmiä hyödynnetään kotihoidon tukipalveluissa ja erityisyksiköissä, joissa asiakkaiden avuntarve voi olla äkillistä ja reagointia edellyttävää. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmät ovat keskeinen osa päivittäistä hoiva, - ja hoitotyötä ja asiakas- sekä potilasturvallisuutta. Niiden avulla varmistetaan, että avunpyynnöt välittyvät viiveettä oikealle henkilöstölle ja että hoitohenkilökunta pystyy priorisoimaan tehtävänsä tilanteen kiireellisyyden mukaan. Samalla ne tukevat henkilöstön työturvallisuutta esimerkiksi uhka- ja vaaratilanteissa sekä mahdollistavat toiminnan seurannan, raportoinnin ja kehittämisen. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmien merkitys korostuu erityisesti tilanteissa, joissa asiakkaiden toimintakyky on heikentynyt, muistisairaudet ovat yleisiä tai hoidon tarve on jatkuvaa. Tällöin järjestelmän toimintavarmuus, helppokäyttöisyys ja integraatio muihin järjestelmiin eivät ole pelkästään teknisiä ominaisuuksia, vaan suoraan hoidon laatuun ja turvallisuuteen vaikuttavia tekijöitä. Hankinnan tavoitteena on varmistaa, että käytössä olevat ratkaisut vastaavat nykyisiä ja tulevia tarpeita. Tämä edellyttää järjestelmiltä skaalautuvuutta, yhteensopivuutta muiden teknologioiden kanssa sekä kykyä mukautua erilaisiin hoitoympäristöihin ilman, että järjestelmien käyttö monimutkaistuu. Samalla varmistetaan, että hankittavat ratkaisut täyttävät tietosuojaa, tietoturvaa ja viranomaisvaatimuksia koskevat velvoitteet. Kokonaisuutena hoitajakutsujärjestelmät ovat kriittinen osa palvelujärjestelmän toimivuutta, ja niiden hankinta tulee toteuttaa siten, että se tukee pitkäjänteisesti palveluiden laatua, turvallisuutta ja kustannustehokkuutta. Puitejärjestelyn kilpailutuksessa on tavoitteena löytää enintään viisi toimittajaa, jotka kykenevät toimittamaan toimialan kohteisiin hoitajakutsujärjestelmän, jolla voidaan hoitaa perinteinen hoitajakutsu (asiakas/potilas voi kutsua hoitajan huoneeseen) ja lisäksi hyödyntää uutta teknologiaa, jonka avulla järjestelmä voi hälyttää hoitajan asiakkaan/potilaan luokse ennakoivasti riskitilanteisiin liittyen (esim. sängyltä nouseminen, kaatuminen). Uuden teknologian avulla pyritään parantamaan asiakas/potilasturvallisuutta lain määrittämissä rajoissa. Hoitajakutsujärjestelmä tarvitaan kaikkiin uusiin ja saneerattaviin sairaaloihin, seniorikeskuksiin jne. Lisäksi sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialalla on useita kohteita, joissa aikoinaan hankittu, mutta vanhentunut hoitajakutsujärjestelmä, jolle toimittaja ei enää tarjoa ylläpitoa ja tukea. Nämä vanhentuneet järjestelmät pitää korvata uusilla. Hankinnan kohteena olevat ratkaisut hankintaan pääasiassa puitejärjestelyyn valittujen toimittajien tarjoamana kokonaispalveluna. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Solicitation Number: 75N98026Q01128 Title: Account Management, Planning, and Maintenance for Online Crowd-Sourced Surveys and Cognitive Tasks for Individuals NAICS CODE: 541990 � All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services Classification Code: R499 � Professional Administrative, and Management Support Services Size Standard: $ 19.5 Million Description. This is a Small Business Sources Sought notice. This is NOT a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding: (1) the availability and capability of qualified small business sources; (2) whether they are small businesses; HUBZone small businesses; service-disabled, veteran-owned small businesses; 8(a) small businesses; veteran-owned small businesses; woman-owned small businesses; or small disadvantaged businesses; (3) their size classification relative to the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the proposed acquisition; and (4) availability of domestic sources manufactured in the United States in sufficient and reasonably available commercial quantities and of a satisfactory quality. For equipment/supply requirements, responses must include the place of manufacturing (i.e. address if supply/equipment is a domestic end product and include country of manufacture). For equipment/supply requirements, small businesses must also address the size status of the manufacturer under the applicable NAICS code (i.e. address Non-Manufacturer Rule). Your responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. An organization that is not considered a small business under the applicable NAICS code should not submit a response to this notice. This notice is issued to help determine the availability of qualified companies technically capable of meeting the Government requirement and to determine the method of acquisition. It is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract. Responses will not be considered as proposals or quotes. No award will be made as a result of this notice. The Government will NOT be responsible for any costs incurred by the respondents to this notice. This notice is strictly for research and information purposes only. Background. The Unit on Computational Decision Neuroscience (CDN) at the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) is requesting to run online surveys of individuals with and without mental health disorders with an online survey provider�s platform. To conduct these studies, NIMH will require a contract for a provider to collect these surveys and provide the responses along with additional demographic information. Purpose and Objectives. The contractor shall provide all resources necessary to accomplish the tasks and deliverables described in this Statement of Work (SOW). The contractor shall provide services for managing accounts for online crowd-sourced research. Salient characteristics include the following: Task: Collecting Survey and Task Responses from Individuals With and Without Depression The Contractor shall provide the participants for the cognitive tasks and surveys. CDN and their collaborators at NIMH will build the cognitive tasks surveys and ensure that they comply with the Contractor�s requirements. The Contractor shall make the tasks and survey(s) available to their panel of respondents until the required number of responses are collected and will manage participant reimbursement. The survey questions may assess the severity of depression and anxiety symptoms and other psychiatric conditions and assess the impact of those symptoms on respondents functioning in day-to-day life. Additionally, we may collect open-ended responses about participants� experiences with the task(s), their condition, and other factors. The responses to survey questions may be collected through the Contractor�s service or through a third-party service to be arranged by CDN. Participants will also complete a battery of cognitive tasks downloaded from servers managed by CDN. Respondents may be required to have a personal computer with Windows 10 or MacOS to complete the cognitive tasks. The collection shall be a combination of surveys and tasks taking up to 45 minutes from at least 2,720 respondents; 680 from each of the following 4 categories: 1) Adults with Anxiety but not depression; 2) Adults with depression but not anxiety; 3) adults with depression and anxiety; 3) and controls with neither anxiety nor depression. Assuming participants are of similar quality in terms of attention, comprehension, and accuracy of screening responses, collection of a greater number of respondents would be preferable. The collection of a combination of surveys and tasks shall be for up to 75 minutes from at least 1,500 high-quality adult respondents fluent in English who have access to a personal computer with Windows 10 or MacOS in order. Participant completion compensation shall be at $20. Government Responsibilities. The government�s responsibilities involve providing feedback to the contractor on the operation of the ongoing online studies if a problem arises. Data Rights. The Government shall have unlimited rights to, and ownership of all deliverables provided under this contract, including reports, recommendations, briefings, work plans and other deliverables. (FAR Clause 52.227-17 Rights in Data- Special Works). Delivery or Deliverables. The contractor shall deliver within 30 days after receipt of the order. Site delivery address shall be, National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH), Building 10, Bethesda, MD 20814. Capability statement /information sought. Companies that believe they possess the capabilities to provide the required products or services should submit documentation of their ability to meet each of the project requirements to the Contracting Officer. The capability statement must specifically address each of the project requirements separately. Additionally, the capability statement should include 1) the total number of employees, 2) the professional qualifications of personnel as it relates to the requirements outlined, 3) any contractor GSA Schedule contracts and/or other government-wide acquisition contracts (GWACs) by which all of the requirements may be met, if applicable, and 4) any other information considered relevant to this program. Capability statements must also include the Company Name, Unique Entity ID from SAM.gov, Physical Address, and Point of Contact Information. The response must include the respondents� technical and administrative points of contact, including names, titles, addresses, telephone and fax numbers, and e-mail addresses. Interested companies are required to identify their type of business, applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code, and size standards in accordance with the Small Business Administration. The government requests that no proprietary or confidential business data be submitted in a response to this notice. However, responses that indicate the information therein is proprietary will be properly safeguarded for Government use only. Capability statements must include the name and telephone number of a point of contact having authority and knowledge to discuss responses with Government representatives. Capability statements in response to this market survey that do not provide sufficient information for evaluation will be considered non-responsive. When submitting this information, please reference the solicitation notice number. Respondents must provide, as part of their responses, a capability statement that clearly identifies their ability to provide the requirements specified in this notice. The respondent must also provide their DUNS number, organization name, address, point of contact, and size and type of busin

title: Sources Sought/Request for Information -Army Dining Facility (DFAC) Food Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) � Germany & Black Sea Region
description: SOURCES SOUGHT / REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) Title: Army Dining Facility (DFAC) Food Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) � Germany & Black Sea Region Notice Type: Sources Sought NAICS Code: 722310 � Food Service Contractors Product Service Code (PSC): M1FD -Operation of Dining Facilities 1.0 INTRODUCTION AND PURPOSE This is a Sources Sought Synopsis / Request for Information (RFI) issued by the Department of the Army 409th Contract Support Brigade (CSB), Theater Contacting Center (TCC). THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified and interested sources capable of providing a full spectrum of Dining Facility (DFAC) food services across U.S. Army garrisons in Germany and the Black Sea region. The Government is contemplating the award of a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) / Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ). This MATOC would utilize a modular Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) structure, allowing individual Task Orders to procure highly customized service packages ranging from full turnkey operations to specific staff augmentation. 2.0 PLANNED SCOPE OF WORK The contemplated MATOC will require contractors to provide varying levels of DFAC support as required by individual Task Orders. Potential service requirements include: Full Food Service (FFS): Turnkey operation including facility management, AFMIS requisitioning, meal preparation, headcount/cashier services, and full facility sanitation. Dining Facility Attendant (DFA) / KP Support: Custodial and sanitation services only (e.g., serving line replenishment, table bussing, mechanical/manual dishwashing, latrine maintenance, deep cleaning). Augmented Food Service (Cooks): Providing qualified Lead Cooks and Cooks to supplement a Government-run kitchen. Specialty Food Operations: Operation of non-standard feeding concepts (e.g., Barista Bars, Grab-N-Go sections). Remote Site & Field Feeding: Preparation/packaging of meals in insulated containers for remote sites and handling of MREs/UGRs. Specific Industry Feedback Requested: DFAC Equipment Maintenance The Government is specifically seeking industry feedback on the feasibility of including Preventative Maintenance and Repair of Government-Furnished food service equipment (GFE) within the scope of this MATOC. We are attempting to determine if bundling equipment repair with food service/DFA labor is appealing to industry or if it would restrict competition. 3.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested parties are requested to submit a response consisting of two parts: Part A: Capability Statement and Part B: Industry Questionnaire. Part A: Capability Statement (Max 3 pages) Please provide a brief Capability Statement that includes: Company Name, CAGE Code, UEI, Address, and Point of Contact. A brief summary of your company�s experience performing similar food service operations in OCONUS environments (specifically Europe). A brief description of your approach to recruiting and retaining qualified personnel (e.g., Lead Cooks with Gesellenbrief or equivalent, English-proficient attendants) in the target regions. Regional and Operational Scalability: Please describe your company�s ability to concurrently manage multiple operations across different geographic regions (e.g., executing a Full Food Service task order in Bavaria, Germany while simultaneously mobilizing a DFA task order in the Black Sea region). Detail your existing logistics pipelines, regional supply chain partnerships, and management overhead structures in Europe that support this regional scalability. 4.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS This RFI/source sought notice will remain open for 21 calendar days from the date of publication, all interested parties must submit their responses no later than 1500 Central European Time (CET) on September 16, 2026 via email to: Contracting Officer Thomas.R.Guyer.civ@army.mil, and Contract Specialist Lisa.Childs.civ@army.mil Please use the subject line: "RFI Response - Army DFAC MATOC (Germany/Black Sea) - [Your Company Name]". The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with preparing and submitting a response to this RFI.

title: E-4B National and Nuclear Communication Support (N2CS) Services
description: To obtain a copy of the draft RFP documents, the government requires the submission of an approved DD 2345. We will not be able to provide a copy of any of the attached documents until the form DD 2345 has been approved. For more information regarding obtaining an approved DD 2345 see the website below: https://www.dla.mil/HQ/LogisticsOperations/Services/JCP/ FAR 5.207(a)(1)-(18): See RFP FA813425RB004. Description: The purpose of the N2CS ID/IQ is to procure sustainment and modernization services for mission communications systems aboard E-4B aircraft. This includes engineering, program management, field service representative support, specialized software sustainment and modernization, cybersecurity support, and facilities management support and expansion development of the System Integration Lab (SIL) necessary to perform the sustainment and modernization of the critical capabilities for the mission communication suite. The mission communication system's primary mission is to serve as the NAOC and is the key component of the National Military Command System (NMCS) for the President, the Secretary of Defense, and the Joint Chiefs of Staff. In case of a national emergency or destruction of ground command and control centers, the E-4B aircraft provides a highly survivable command and control communications center to direct United States Forces, execute emergency war orders, and coordinate action by civil authorities. Additionally, the E-4B provides outside the continental United States travel support for the Secretary of Defense and his staff to ensure Title 10 command and control connectivity; and it supports Federal Emergency Management Agency by providing communications and command center capability to relief efforts following natural disasters. The success of the E-4B mission is dependent on its ability to communicate effectively. The total estimated contract ceiling amount is $984M, with an ordering period of up to 10 years with the last order ending 18-months after the last option is exercised in accordance with FAR 52.217-8, if needed. This Class J&A covers all contract actions including options and task orders for all CLINs. The ID/IQ will have a $500,000 minimum order amount, which will be met with the first order issued in conjunction with the basic contract award. A ten (10) year ordering period broken up into options that are based on three-year increments mirroring the anticipated pricing arrangements until the last year is in the Government's best interest to provide uninterrupted service. Because the Basic ID/IQ will mirror the pricing structure increments, it will flow logically for future contract administration. Included within the contract are the following types of fund appropriations: Sustainment (3400): This includes Field Service Representatives, Program Management, Recurring/Non-recurring Engineering, Recurring/Non-recurring Software Engineering, Materials/Spares, Mission Support Facility (MSF) Ops & Maintenance, SIL Sustainment and Technology Refresh, Low-Cost Modifications, Other Sustainment, Transportation, Travel, and Data. Research and Development (3600): This includes Non-recurring Engineering, Non-recurring Software Engineering, Modifications, SIL Expansion and Modernization, Prototype Kit Development, Travel, and Data Modifications (3010): This includes Non-recurring Engineering, Non-recurring Software Engineering, Materials, Modifications, Travel, Data and Transportation Requirements identified within the basic Performance Work Statement (PWS) include Support Tasks for liaison engineering to address specific tasks requirements, cybersecurity initiatives, scheduling, and other related quality assurance system modernization, planning, and program management to assist in resolving issues including, but not limited to: engineering data/vendors, logistics, certifications, test support, maintenance, troubleshooting emergency maintenance off-site and on aircraft, planning, communication suite modifications tech refreshes and upgrades, system integration lab expansion, modernization, and sustainment, studies to upgrade current systems and address obsolescence issues, and for material and other direct costs necessary for the overall sustainment of the mission communication suite. This ID/IQ CLIN structure will include separately priced CLINS for intellectual property (IP) rights. All applicable data rights clauses will be contained within the base ID/IQ contract and each task order will identify the appropriate IP rights the contractor will grant and elver under the task order. description: Tο Υπερταμείο (ΕΕΣΥΠ) προσκαλεί δυνητικούς επενδυτές να υποβάλουν εκδήλωση ενδιαφέροντος («Εκδήλωση Ενδιαφέροντος» ή «ΕΕ») για τη μακροπρόθεσμη παραχώρηση του δικαιώματος διοίκησης, διαχείρισης, λειτουργίας, ανάπτυξης, επέκτασης, συντήρησης και εκμετάλλευσης 22 Περιφερειακών Αεροδρομίων στην Ελλάδα διάρκειας περί τα σαράντα (40) έτη (η «Συναλλαγή»). Η ακριβής διάρκεια της παραχώρησης θα καθοριστεί από την ΕΕΣΥΠ στην πρόσκληση υποβολής προσφορών που θα εκδοθεί στη δεύτερη φάση της Διαγωνιστικής Διαδικασίας (η «Πρόσκληση Υποβολής Προσφορών» ή «ΠΥΠ»). Προβλέπεται ότι η ΕΕΣΥΠ, το Ελληνικό Δημόσιο ("ΕΔ") και ο Προτιμητέος Επενδυτής που θα αναδειχθεί από τον διαγωνισμό θα συνάψουν σύμβαση παραχώρησης (η «Σύμβαση Παραχώρησης»). Για τους σκοπούς σύναψης της Σύμβασης Παραχώρησης, ο Προτιμητέος Επενδυτής θα συστήσει εταιρεία ειδικού σκοπού (η «ΕΕΣ» ή ο «Παραχωρησιούχος») με τη μορφή ανώνυμης εταιρείας σύμφωνα με τους νόμους της Ελλάδας με έδρα στην Ελλάδα. Η διάρκεια της παραχώρησης μπορεί να παραταθεί υπό τους όρους που θα καθοριστούν στη Σύμβαση Παραχώρησης που θα συναφθεί και με την επιφύλαξη των διατάξεων της ισχύουσας νομοθεσίας. Ο βασικός στόχος που επιθυμεί να επιτύχει η ΕΕΣΥΠ μέσω της Συναλλαγής είναι η μεγιστοποίηση των εσόδων που θα καταβληθούν στην ΕΕΣΥΠ από την οντότητα στην οποία θα ανατεθεί η παραχώρηση. Η ΕΕΣΥΠ στοχεύει επίσης στην επίτευξη και εξασφάλιση ενός συνδυασμού υπηρεσιών λειτουργίας και συντήρησης υψηλής ποιότητας για τους Αερολιμένες, καθώς και στην ουσιαστική ανακαίνιση και ανάπτυξη των εγκαταστάσεων, όπως θα ορίζεται περαιτέρω στη Β' Φάση του διαγωνισμού, προς όφελος των τελικών χρηστών αλλά και των εξυπηρετούμενων προορισμών. Σημειώνεται δε ότι τμήμα των προς εκτέλεση απαιτούμενων έργων ενδέχεται να τύχει επιχορήγησης με την ένταξή του σε σχετικό πρόγραμμα επιχορήγησης ή λοιπά χρηματοδοτικά προγράμματα χρηματοδοτούμενα από εθνικούς ή/και από ευρωπαϊκούς πόρους ή να τύχει άμεσης ή έμμεσης χρηματοδοτικής συμβολής ή ενίσχυσης από το ΕΔ, οπότε στην περίπτωση αυτή οι σχετικές λεπτομέρειες θα προσδιορίζονται στη Β' Φάση. Η Συναλλαγή θα λάβει τη μορφή συναλλαγής με μετρητά. Ως εκ τούτου, καμία εναλλακτική μορφή ανταλλάγματος (π.χ. περιουσιακά στοιχεία, μετοχές εταιρειών ή άλλες κινητές αξίες) δεν γίνεται αποδεκτή από την ΕΕΣΥΠ. Προς αποφυγή αμφιβολιών, η παρούσα παράγραφος δεν περιορίζει το δικαίωμα της ΕΕΣΥΠ να απαιτήσει την καταβολή πρόσθετης προσόδου (earn-out) ή τυχόν παρεμφερούς μεταβλητού ανταλλάγματος.

title: Intent to Sole Source Westlaw Advantage Online Subscription
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE / LIMITED-SOURCE DELIVERY ORDER TO WESTLAW PUBLISHING 1. Purpose of Notice The Department of the Treasury, Treasury Common Services Center (TCSC), on behalf of the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), intends to issue a sole source firm-fixed-price delivery order to West Publishing Corporation, doing business as West, a Thomson Reuters business, under FEDLINK Contract No. LCFDL23D0027 for Westlaw Advantage online legal research subscriptions. This notice is prepared for posting to SAM.gov as a notice of intent and is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. 2. Description of Requirement FinCEN requires continued access to Westlaw Advantage online legal research subscriptions for 30 authorized agency users. The subscription includes Westlaw Advantage National Primary, Analytical Plus, Litigation, Practical Law, and Government Contracts Counselor content. The requirement supports legal research, procurement, compliance, and mission support needs of FinCEN users and requires uninterrupted access by September 30, 2026. The contractor shall provide the subscription content and Westlaw Advantage training at no additional cost to the Government, including self-paced online training and one-on-one custom training with the contractor account management team. 3. Intended Source The intended source is West Publishing Corporation, doing business as West, a Thomson Reuters business, 2900 Ames Crossing Road, Suite 100, Eagan, MN 55121. The proposal identifies West Publishing Corporation as the legal contracting entity and identifies UEI L997DB4PEJL8 and CAGE Code 89101. 4. Authority and Regulatory Basis The acquisition is contemplated as a sole source delivery order under the FEDLINK indefinite-delivery vehicle. The Contracting Officer shall use the final authority applicable to the selected ordering procedure and include the completed limited-source, sole-source, brand-name, or exception-to-fair-opportunity documentation in the contract file. For an order under an indefinite-delivery contract, the draft basis is FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B), because only one awardee/source is capable of providing the supplies or services required at the level of quality required due to the unique and highly specialized proprietary Westlaw Advantage content and functionality. To the extent the action is treated as other than full and open competition outside FAR 16.505 ordering procedures, FAR 6.302-1, Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements, supports the sole-source rationale. Public notice is prepared consistent with FAR Subpart 5.2, including FAR 5.201 and FAR 5.207 requirements for synopses of proposed contract actions, as applicable. 5. Rationale for Sole Source / Limited Source Westlaw Advantage is proprietary to West Publishing Corporation/Thomson Reuters. The required content and functionality include Westlaw Advantage National Primary, Analytical Plus, Litigation, Practical Law, Government Contracts Counselor, KeyCite, West Key Number System, Westlaw editorial enhancements, AIpowered legal research tools, and associated online legal research functionality. FinCEN currently relies on the Westlaw Subscription Service for online legal research. A lapse in access would create mission and schedule risk for users who rely on the platform for legal research, procurement, compliance, and mission support. Market research did not identify another source capable of providing the required proprietary Westlaw Advantage subscription content. The requirement is not suitable for a small business set-aside because the required content is proprietary and available from West Publishing Corporation through the FEDLINK vehicle. 6. Period of Performance and Estimated Value The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month base period from September 30, 2026, through September 29, 2027, with two 12-month option periods through September 29, 2029. 7. Response Instructions Interested parties may identify their interest and submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the content and functionality of the Westlaw Advantage subscription described in this notice. Capability statements must include evidence that the respondent can provide the proprietary content, authorized user access, training/support, technical capability to train employees. Responses must be submitted electronically to the Contracting Officer\Contract Specialist identified in the SAM.gov notice no later than September 17, 2026. Please email responses to: joshua.roberts@treasury.gov and hawa.janneh@treasury.gov Responses received after the deadline may not be considered. The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with preparation or submission of capability statements. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. This notice is not a solicitation and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation, award a contract, or pay proposal preparation costs. Hawa Janneh Contracting Officer

title: B&F 26Z5AV7 - Emergency Repair of Elevator C&D
description: Solicitation Notice: Elevator C and D Modernization � FDC Houston Project Overview The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP), Federal Detention Center � Houston (FDC Houston) intends to award a contract to a responsible entity for the repair and modernization of Elevators C and D. The facility is located at 1200 Texas Avenue, Houston, Texas 77002. The awarded contractor will be required to provide all labor, materials, tools, permits, and equipment necessary to safely repair and modernize Elevators C and D, along with their associated components and subassemblies. All work shall be compliant with ASME A17.1 safety codes, as well as all applicable Local, State, and Federal codes and safety requirements. Contractor Qualifications The awarded contractor shall be a reputable Elevator Service Provider with proven experience in commercial elevator equipment. All assigned Contractor Journeyman Level Field Technicians shall possess applicable manufacturer removal and disassembly certifications reflecting competency in the specific equipment being removed. The Contractor shall provide proof of these certifications to the Institution�s Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). Scope of Work The scope of work includes the removal and replacement of, but is not limited to, Elevators C and D electronic and electrical components, drive/controller, hoist motor, hoistway leveling device(s), governor, traction ropes, traveling cable, and car components to return Elevators C and D to fully operational status. Start-up, commissioning, and staff training are required. The contractor shall perform job site clean-up and removal of all excess materials, debris, and old equipment associated with the project. Removal and disposal of all debris must be completed in accordance with all applicable Federal, State, and Local laws. The contractor shall haul away and dispose of the old equipment through an approved, licensed scrap metal recycling entity within five (5) business days of its removal from the institution. Evidence of the appropriate recycling action shall be provided to the institution�s Contracting Officer via a tonnage weight receipt delivered to FDC Houston. Please see the attached Statement of Work (SOW) for specific requirements. Pre-Bid Site Visit and Security Instructions There will be a site visit at FDC Houston on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 9:00 AM CST. It is strongly advised that the Contractor attends this pre-bid site visit to review the existing conditions that might affect the performance of the contracted work. If you wish to attend, you must email the required background check paperwork (NCIC form) for every individual wishing to enter the institution to Nathan Vandiver (nvandiver@bop.gov) and Daniel Cruz (dcruz-ayala@bop.gov). Security Deadline: Background check paperwork is strictly due by Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 1:00 PM CST. Signature Requirement: Please do not digitally sign your name on the background check form; a physical wet signature is required. Digital or electronic signatures will result in immediate gate rejection. Identification: All attendees must present a valid state or federal photo ID to enter the facility. Submission of Quotes Completed quotes may be submitted electronically via email to dcruz-ayala@bop.gov. All responsible sources must submit a typed quote on the attached specification sheet (RFQ � SF 1442 15B51726Q00000014 B&F Project 26Z5AV7 - Emergency Repair and Modernization of Elevators C and D), which will be considered for award. Do not submit multiple quote requests.
